english: Scrap Storage Core
The heart of a StashNet storage network. Drive Bays and Terminals within 6 blocks connect to it. Lock it with a code to protect the network's Drive Bays and Terminals.
Drive Bay
Holds up to 4 storage drives. Only accepts drives. Protected by its network Core's code.
Storage Terminal
Browse, search, deposit and withdraw everything stored on your network's drives.
Crafting Terminal
A workbench wired into your storage network. Same recipes and skills as a workbench, but it can use ingredients stored on the network's drives (within 6 blocks of a Storage Core).
Fetching ingredients from storage... click Craft again.
Basic Drive
A crude storage drive. Holds 24 stacks, like a small chest. Its contents stay on the drive, even when removed. Only readable inside a StashNet network.
